description: Saskatoon Fire Department upgraded 911 dispatch to digital.
This improves call location accuracy and emergency response.
Future 911 will support text, video, and smart vehicle calls.

chips.text: Received as information

Staff promised to email committee the proportional breakdown of the $168,000 project surplus.
